blocks.content: In this example, we will create a program to convert decimal numbers to binary numbers.
For example, 6 in the decimal system is equal to 110 in binary.
We can convert a decimal number to binary by dividing the number by 2 and keeping track of the remainder at each step.

items: Record the remainder. It will be either 0 or 1.
Use the quotient (the result of the division) from the previous step as the new number to divide by 2.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 until the quotient becomes 0.
The binary equivalent is the series of remainders read from bottom to top (or from the last remainder obtained to the first).

blocks.content: Let's see how we can convert the decimal number 6 to binary.
